response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications including C programming for UNIX embedded systems, Linux kernel modification experience, native Japanese proficiency, and any demonstrated background in network security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), switch firmware, or embedded device control — all essential for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated expertise in open-source contributions and developer tooling
Proven ability to work on complex systems including real-time and distributed applications
concerns: No evidence of C programming in UNIX/embedded environments or Linux kernel work
Lacks native Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement
No experience with networking security technologies, switch firmware, or embedded hardware control

key_factors.factor: No embedded C or Linux kernel experience
No security or networking switch domain experience
